summary: Sedona, Arizona, independent consultant, extensive experience in software development, particularly in Ruby, Common Lisp, and Java, author of multiple technical books, strong interest in semantic web technologies, active in cloud computing (AWS, Google App Engine), enjoys hiking and cooking, family-oriented, values locally grown organic food, critical of corporate practices, advocates for financial prudence and minimal debt, has a pet parrot, engaged in community and family activities, interested in programming languages and their ecosystems, follows developments in AI and machine learning, has a background in game development and virtual reality, prefers working from home, emphasizes the importance of work-life balance.
